description: Real security review for code: OWASP Top 10, injection, secrets, and dependency risks. Cross-references imported dependencies against OSV.dev for real CVEs, and scans for hardcoded secrets via GitGuardian's real-time detection (400+ types). SPENDS your balance — requires FD_API_KEY. Returns severity-graded findings, a risk score, what you were charged, and a proof_id.

code.description: The code to scan for security vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, injection, secrets, dependency risks).

max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to poll (default 60, agent typically takes ~45s). On timeout, returns task_id to poll later.

name: forcedream_security_scan
title: Scan code for security vulnerabilities
